main_text.p: גומרי, Syr. ܓܘܡܪܝ Carbones, ad Roman.12.20. Johan.21.9.
גנא גני Ch. Decumbere, cubare, Jobi 40.16. Ethpeh. Syr. ܓܢܐ ܙܝ Subduxit, subtraxit se, Joh.5.13.
גנאי Chald. Turpitudo, Ignominia, Res turpis & inhonesta.
גנותא, גנוותא Ch. Idem, Genef.34.14. in Targ. Jonath. Ecclef.5.5.
גנב Chald. & Syr. Furatus est, Furtim surripuit, abstulit. Pahel גנב Idē. Ithpeh. אתגנב Furto auferri.
גנבא, גנבא Chald. & Syr. Fur. Plur. גנבין Fures.
גניבותא, גנובתא Ch. Furtū, Exod.22.3.4. in Onk. & Jon.
גונבא Ch. Cauda, Deut.14.10. in Jon. idem quod דונבא.
גב, גבי Syr. Idem quod Chald. גב, גבי, Dages nempe resoluto in ܠ; sed semper praefixum habet ܒ: ܓܒ Ad, apud, juxta, penes, super.
גנר Ch. Pahel Volvit, devolvit, Genef.29.10. Part. ומגנרין Et devolvebant, ibid.v.31. 1.Reg.14.10.
גנז Ch. Abscondere, recondere, reponere, asservare, thesaurizare. Ithpeh. Futur. ולא יתגנז Et non recondetur, vel reponetur in thesaurum, Jesa.23.18.
גניז Ch. Absconditum, abditum, reconditum, occultum: Hinc Syr. ܓܢܝܙܐ Dei reconditi, ignoti, Act.17.23. Plur. גניזין, גנייזיא; Fœmin. גניזן.

page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac words are reproduced as far as legible; the pointed Hebrew and Syriac forms in the scan are partly damaged, and several Syriac and Hebrew forms are uncertain.
